notes.title: [CHALLENGE] Capture Your Best Gameplay Session with IA !
notes.content:
[h1] Capture Your Best Gameplay Session with IA ![/h1]

🎮  Are you passionate about [b]Felon-E[/b] and love sharing your achievements? 
This contest is for you! 
We invite you to participate by recording and sharing the best gameplay sequence from our game. 
Get ready to impress the community and win exclusive rewards!

[u][h2]How to participate?[/h2][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030867/a1c41c54d5d4e56000c267a8e517677d5fc1806f.jpg[/img]

[h3]🖥️Record Your Gameplay:[/h3]

· Capture a video of your most intense moment while interacting with an NPC. Show off your skill and creativity!

· Use OBS or the new game recording feature available on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/gamerecording]Game Recording sur Steam[/url].

[h3]🎥Submit Your Video:[/h3]

· Upload the sequence, which should not exceed 1 minute, to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, or any other video-sharing platform.
· Send us the link to your video via email to [url=playtest@jumbomana.com][b][u]playtest@jumbomana.com[/u][/b][/url] along with your [u][b]Steam username.[/b][/u].
· Option to share the video on the [b]Felon-E[/b] community on Steam
· ⚠️Please Add [b]#FelonE[/b] and [b]#FelonePlaytest[/b] on your publications

[h3]🔥Selection Criteria:[/h3]

· [u][b]Creativity: [/b][/u] The originality of the question posed
· [b][u]Performance: [/u][/b] The originality and ingenuity of your gameplay sequence.
· [b][u]Voice: [/u][/b] The quality and uniqueness of your voice recording for a dubbing audition.

[b][u][h3]🎁Rewards:[/h3][/u][/b]

· Mention on the game's honor board.
· Invitation to test beta versions of our future content.
· Special mention on our social media.
· VIP invitation (entry badge) to our events (Gamescom, PGW, etc.)
· Discount coupons for future purchases in your Steam store.
· Exclusive profile wallpapers.
· The next character will feature your personality, the name of your choice, and your voice.

[b][u][h3]⏳Key Dates[/h3][/u][/b]

· Contest Start: [b]07/02/2024[/b]
· Submission Deadline: [b]07/31/2024[/b]
· Winner Announcement: [b]08/05/2024[/b]

notes.title: [NEW] Top départ SESSION DE PLAYTEST Felon-E !
notes.content:
[h2]Adepts of the Holy Gear[/h2]

Our henchmen have been hard at work, and we're now proud to announce the start of the closed Playtest session for the whole month of July!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030867/a1c41c54d5d4e56000c267a8e517677d5fc1806f.jpg[/img]

You can now Request access to the game demo so you can test our AIs and take on Colbert Metalcreux, a priest with a very... special personality.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504610/FelonE/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030867/4b801008999432fff8138b7074013cb15ba2741c.png[/img][/url]
[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2504610/FelonE/]Participate in the Felon-E Playtest[/url][/h2]
In order to better manage the Playtest session and server access, we've decided to open up access to the Playtest session gradually. Make an access request via Steam and you'll be promptly notified of your access to the game. 

We hope you have a great time playing Felon-E, and we look forward to your feedback to help us improve the game. 
You can fill in the [h3][url=https://forms.office.com/e/AMTCeDjZHC]Playtest Form[/url][/h3]
We look forward to seeing many of you at the launch event, and to seeing how your interactions affect the game.

If you encounter any problems during your Playtest session, please report them to us on the 
following Discussion chanel:
[h3] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2504610/discussions/2/][Playtest] Felon-E July 2024 Discussions[/url][/h3]

Boubli Boulga ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030867/0b99f292261c99c3a9ef0a242245cea5b5debbda.gif[/img]

Quentin, from the Felon-E development team.

notes.title: [NEW] PLAYTEST SESSION Starting JULY 2024
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45030867/e6ece0c36790e5d3a44a2b9ce828ce84478e2e3f.gif[/img]

[h2]Your attention dear Holy Gear Cultists ![/h2]

We're pleased to invite you to a closed Playtest session to try our 1st game level, discover the Catacombs and chat with NPCs !
[h3]Get your microphones ready, the Playtest session will run from 

[h1][b]2nd of July 2024 to 31st of July 2024[/b][/h1]


Let's chat with the adepts of the Holy Gear and confront Colbert Metalcreux in a refreshing exorcism session... 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45030867/8cbf356e9583e34883ca6f82735aa92d2741d4ad.jpg[/img]

We look forward to seeing many of you at this playtest session. Please leave a review and share it widely. Your help and support are crucial to launching this amazing project.

Boulgi Boulga!  



                                                                                                        Quentin, from the Felon-E Dev Team.
